text:
Jordan: Morning all :wave: I'm Jordan (joined last week) — jumping onto my first on-call shift today. Quick questions: I don't see the pager in Opsgenie, and I can't access the prod_runbook link from Confluence. Who should I ping for access? Also wondering if there's a short checklist for first shifts?

Alex: Welcome! :tada: Pager access should be automatic after you accepted the on-call invite — check Opsgenie under Teams > Redwood Oncall. If not, ping @DevEx. Checklist: 1) confirm pager, 2) runbooks, 3) slack incident channel, 4) shadow with a buddy first hour. I'll paste a quick checklist.

Alex: ```
First shift checklist:
- Confirm Opsgenie pager + mobile app notifications
- Verify runbook access: https://confluence.redwood/prod_runbooks
- Join #incidents and #eng-oncall
- Run smoke test: curl -I https://status-api.redwood/prod/health
- Pair with on-call buddy (first 60m)
```

Maria: If you can't access Confluence, we need your Okta group. @Jordan please confirm your corporate email + whether you accepted the Confluence invite. Also check VPN — run `vpn-status`.

OncallBot: Incident playbook link: https://playbooks.redwood/incident-response. If a P0, call +1-555-0123 and tag @pager.

DevEx: @Jordan I just checked — your Okta groups look partial. I pushed the `eng-oncall` group; try accessing again. You may need to re-login. If still blocked, DM me and I'll escalate.

Sam: I'm on shift now; happy to pair for your first paging. Send me a ping and we can shadow for the first hour.

Jordan: Thanks all. Relogged, Confluence still 403 though. Opsgenie shows me as 'pending' — didn't get mobile push. I accepted the invite email earlier. Mobile is iOS 16.6.

Alex: Opsgenie sometimes needs a manual accept from org admin. @DevEx, can you force-accept Opsgenie invite for Jordan? Meanwhile, Jordan, try uninstalling/reinstalling Opsgenie mobile and check notification permissions.

DevEx: Done — I forced add you to Opsgenie team. You should see 'Redwood Oncall' under Teams now. If not immediately, log out/in. Also added you to Confluence group; should be propagated in ~2 min.

Jordan: Perfect — I see the team now, and mobile push test worked :thumbsup:. I can access prod_runbooks too. One more Q: during an incident, do we page the SRE infra team or the model infra team for runtime GPU OOMs?

Alex: For GPU runtime OOMs, page 'eng-runtime' first (they own the serving runtime). If it's clearly model quality/regression, page 'eng-ml'. There's a routing note in the runbook under 'Who to page'.

Maria: Also FYI, for first week don't do escalations without pairing unless it's P0. You're good to shadow with Sam.

Jordan: Got it. Thanks everyone — pinging Sam to start shadowing now.
